description: Q1-2025 Solar Photovoltaic System Cost Benchmarks is a data set deposited in DOE National Library of the Rockies (NLR) Repository by its authors Paul Basore, Krysta Dummit (United States Department of Energy). The U.S. Department of Energy’s solar office and its national laboratory partners analyze cost data for U.S. solar photovoltaic systems to develop cost benchmarks to measure progress toward goals and guide research and development programs. The cost data is available in an Excel spreadsheet model that can be downloaded here. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 7 files.. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29).
